about: Water names in TX's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for TX: TCEQ's Sanitary Sewer Overflows table (data.texas.gov 8kc5-95uk, read 2026-11-07; the receiving water a report gives, once per report), with the counties, permits and TCEQ segment codes of the reports naming each. Records naming no water and texts that are not a water's name are left out (by_reason). Texas Beach Watch names no water: its stations are placed by their points. Written by scripts/tx_report_water_names.py.
